⚡ Real-Time / Offline Edge Architecture
Navigation continues locally when GNSS or internet connectivity is unavailable.
• Zero Cloud Dependency: AI forward speed GRU and 8D Adaptive EKF operate locally on-device at 50Hz.
• Autonomous Dead Reckoning: Non-Holonomic Constraints (NHC) sustain trajectory in tunnels/urban canyons.
• Gated Smooth Recovery: Innovation gating validates returning GNSS signals to eliminate position jumps.
